metadata.task: If the bedroom door is closed, open it before retrieving the backpack.

plan.goal: Open the bedroom door if closed, then retrieve the backpack from inside.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Verify the state of the bedroom door (closed/open) and navigate to the bedroom entrance.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Main Entrance; Door state unknown.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at Bedroom Entrance; Door state determined (Closed or Open).

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_023 detects door location and state (open/closed) required to determine if opening is necessary.
Skill NAV_015 moves the fixed-base robot to the semantic location of the bedroom to enable interaction.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Open the bedroom door if it is detected as closed.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Bedroom Entrance; Door state is Closed.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot at Bedroom Entrance; Door state is Open.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_013 uses the manipulator to physically open the door handle/surface since the robot lacks autonomous door actuation but has dexterous manipulation.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the backpack location inside the bedroom.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Bedroom Entrance; Door is Open.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_014 navigates the robot to the pose of the detected backpack within the bedroom.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot at Backpack location; Door is Open.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_001 uses MoveIt2 to grasp and pick the backpack using the robot's dexterous hands.

constraints: Robot is fixed-base (cannot navigate globally, relies on local manipulation/navigated poses).
Robot has no visual perception (assumes prior knowledge or manual teleop for object detection).
Robot has no audio (cannot receive voice commands).
Door opening requires manual manipulation due to lack of door actuator.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Robot successfully opens the bedroom door (if closed), navigates to the backpack, and picks it up.
